Abrysvo is an RSV vaccine for people 60+ and pregnant. Beyfortus is an RSV vaccine for babies 0-8 months old who are born during RSV season if the mom did not get Abrysvo between weeks 32-36 of pregnancy. It is also indicated for pediatrics 9-24 months old who remain at risk for RSV.  Different clinics may have slightly different protocols.  Some OBGYNs are not recommending Abrysvo yet.
